ruleDefinitions.name: New Port Forwarding Rule Added Via Netsh.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of netsh commands that configure a new port forwarding (PortProxy) rule

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\netsh\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "netsh\.exe") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*interface.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*portproxy.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*v4tov4.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*i\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*p\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*a\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*v\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*connectp.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*listena.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*c\\=.*")))
